# Vyre

> Vyre is the agentic command center for AI-native teams. Our mission is to help every professional services team become AI-native. People and agents share chats, records, tasks, files and automations (Flows) on a server the team owns, and anything that leaves the team waits for a person's yes. Open source (Apache 2.0), self-hosted, any model: Claude, Codex, Grok and OpenRouter through your own subscriptions or keys. Reach it from the Vyre app on a Mac, on Windows, on a phone, or in a browser.

Current release: 0.5.0. Site: https://vyre.run. Source: https://github.com/vyre-ai/vyre. Licence: Apache 2.0. Vyre is free; you pay your AI providers directly.

## Start here
- [Home](https://vyre.run/): what Vyre is and what it does
- [Get started](https://vyre.run/start/): the steps, from the Vyre app to pairing your server
- [Architecture](https://vyre.run/architecture/): how Vyre is built, on one page: layers, how a call flows, how an agent's turn runs, the Gate
- [Vault](https://vyre.run/vault/): how credentials are sealed, shared by grant, lease or use-only pass, and used by agents without a model seeing a value
- [Records](https://vyre.run/records/): custom types, links with inverses, link hops in tokens, stage sets, views, sealed fields, import and export
- [Flows](https://vyre.run/flows/): triggers, approved versions, the replay-safe runner and holds for a person
- [Agents](https://vyre.run/agents/): instructions, memory, access, and how a task wakes an agent that finishes, hands on or says stuck
- [Direction](https://vyre.run/direction/): where Vyre is going (direction, not a promise of dates)
- [For professional services firms](https://vyre.run/for/): client journeys on Vyre by kind of firm
- [Vyre for law firms](https://vyre.run/for/law-firms/): Inquiry, screening and conflict check, consultation, engagement letter signed, matter opened from a Playbook, deadlines from a trigger date, documents from the firm’s own templates, client updates, billing hand-off.
- [Vyre for accounting firms](https://vyre.run/for/accounting-firms/): Inquiry and scoping, engagement letter signed, client onboarding, document collection with reminders, a monthly close Playbook, tax season tracks, review and delivery, billing and renewal.
- [Vyre for consulting firms](https://vyre.run/for/consulting-firms/): Inquiry, scoping call, proposal, statement of work signed, engagement from a Playbook, weekly status, change requests, final report and renewal.
- [Vyre for marketing and creative agencies](https://vyre.run/for/marketing-agencies/): Inquiry, discovery and brief, proposal and statement of work signed, onboarding with access in the Vault, a campaign Playbook per offer, creative review rounds, client approval, monthly report, renewal.
- [Vyre for real estate brokerages](https://vyre.run/for/real-estate-brokerages/): Lead response, qualification, listing or buyer agreement signed, a transaction from a Playbook, key dates from the contract date, documents, client updates, closing and follow-up.
- [Privacy](https://vyre.run/privacy/): what Vyre knows about you, which is almost nothing

## Devices
- [Mac: Vyre](https://vyre.run/mac/): the Vyre app in its own window
- [Windows: Vyre](https://vyre.run/windows/): tray app with an Alt+Space panel
- [Linux server](https://vyre.run/linux/): where Vyre runs
- [Phone](https://vyre.run/phone/): the Vyre app, sideloaded on Android (APK) or iPhone (Xcode)
- [Downloads](https://vyre.run/downloads/): every file and install line, from the latest GitHub release

## Vyre Computer
- [Vyre Computer](https://vyre.run/computer/): how agents work on real computers: your Chrome, your Mac and computers of their own, with logins from the Vault and every send held at the Gate
- [Vyre for Chrome](https://vyre.run/computer/chrome/): what it does today and how to install it, standalone for Claude Code or native inside Vyre, plus the Vault fill extension
- [Chrome control, architecture](https://vyre.run/computer/architecture/): how it drives a site through the site's own API calls, remembers how each site works, plans, holds sends for approval, stops on Esc and logs

## Machine-readable
- [llms-full.txt](https://vyre.run/llms-full.txt): the same content in full
- [agents.md](https://vyre.run/agents.md): guidance for AI agents that install or operate Vyre
- [sitemap.xml](https://vyre.run/sitemap.xml)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/vyre-ai/vyre)
- [Map your business onto Vyre](https://github.com/vyre-ai/vyre/blob/main/docs/for-agents/MAP-YOUR-BUSINESS.md): a method an AI agent follows to turn a business into members, records, Flows, agents and Gate rules
